observations: Photo 0 shows a top-loading washing machine with a front control panel area not visible.
Brand label on the lid/front reads “NEXUS”.
No visible model number, capacity (kg), or rating plate details in the photo.
No photo of the drum interior, power-on screen/controls, hoses, or any test running.

claims.evidence: Location is not shown in photo 0.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show purchase date, age, or usage hours.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows no motor access, service history, or functional test.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Unknown model/capacity and whether it’s fully functional (spin/drain/agitation) — photos don’t confirm operation.
risks.proof: Short video of a full wash cycle including fill, agitation, drain, and spin (or at least spin) with water running.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used washing machine with unverified working condition (worst case: not confirmed to work).

risks.risk: Possible hidden issues (leaks, weak pump, noisy motor, worn suspension) not visible externally.
risks.proof: Video showing the machine running on a level surface with a quick check for leaks under/around the base during drain/spin.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing service (worst case: may have faults).

risks.risk: Model number not readable; wrong variant can change parts availability and value.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/model sticker (usually at the back or inside lid) showing model number and capacity (kg).
risks.if_unproven: Price using the lowest-value assumption for an unknown NEXUS top-loader variant.

risks.risk: Accessories/installation items may be missing (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable, manual).
risks.proof: Photo laid out of all included parts: inlet hose, drain hose, power cable, and any accessories/manual.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/uncertain accessories (worst case: buyer must source missing parts).

proof_requests: Photo of the rating plate/model sticker (model number + capacity in kg).
Video of a full wash cycle showing fill → wash/agitate → drain → spin.
Video/photo confirming no leaks during drain/spin (check under the base).
Photos of included accessories (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable, manual) and the receipt/warranty card.
response.reason: The photo identifies the brand (NEXUS) and type (top-loading washing machine), but it does not show the model/capacity or any functional test. Since the seller’s “no fault” claim is unverified remotely, the correct price depends on proof of working condition and exact model.
